IATF Blender factory produced measurable MP4 volume but Visual QA PASS at scale is unproven.
CAE VOF/OpenRadioss MP4s are scientific visualization, not cinematic gen-AI (separate track).
Document/RAG ingest (3D_ANIMATION domain) does not raise video L levels.
